harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired the CentOS 5-compatible replay utility. Recovery now delivers once per Message-ID, preserves distinct same-subject messages, respects the existing delivery index, retains the original spool and old delivery, and quarantines malformed messages with an explanation. State remained correct after reruns and a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Replaced bin/replay with POSIX-shell recovery logic.
Recovered <a@branch.test> and <b@branch.test> exactly once while preserving <old@branch.test>.
Verified byte-for-byte idempotence on repeated recovery.
Restarted node1 safely and verified changed boot identity, service recovery, persistent data, and unchanged CentOS/kernel versions.

evidence.requirement: Recover pending messages exactly once per Message-ID without losing distinct same-subject messages
evidence.summary: Index contains exactly one old, a, and b ID; a and b both retain Subject: Notice with distinct Message-IDs.

evidence.requirement: Skip deliveries already recorded in delivered/index.tsv on rerun
evidence.summary: Delivered and quarantine hashes were unchanged across reruns before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Preserve original spool and already-delivered message
evidence.summary: All four original spool files remain, content comparisons pass, and old.eml remains indexed and delivered.

evidence.requirement: Quarantine malformed messages with an explanation
evidence.summary: bad.eml is quarantined intact with a reason identifying a missing, duplicate, or malformed Message-ID header.

evidence.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 were unchanged across the repair and restart.
Healthy baseline boot ID e4ff928a… was captured, native shutdown acknowledged, post-restart boot ID changed to 169b7f1e…, SSH recovered, and replay/data checks passed.
